title: Grammar — Present and Past: Be; Present Simple (My Next Grammar, Lessons 4-5)
intro: Lesson 4: am / is / are and was / were. Lesson 5: present simple verbs and subject-verb agreement (SVA). Includes hidden-subject, error-spotting, and rewrite items at the Grade 5 high-standard level, plus the exact homework sentences.

explanation.title: Be Verbs and Present Simple Quick Guide
explanation.intro: 這次 Grammar 考兩件事：be 動詞的現在式和過去式，以及一般現在式動詞要不要加 -s / 用 do 還是 does。

cards.formula: I am / he, she, it is / you, we, they are
cards.meaning: 現在的狀態。主詞是 I 用 am；單數第三人稱（he / she / it / 一個人或東西）用 is；you / 複數用 are。
examples: I am ten years old.
The weather is sunny now.
Those girls are so mean to the new student.
There are many reasons to brush your teeth.

cards.formula: I, he, she, it was / you, we, they were
cards.meaning: 過去的狀態。單數用 was，複數和 you 用 were。句子裡有 yesterday、last night、this morning、ago 常常是過去式。
examples: The cat was hungry this morning.
Where were you when I called last night?
There was a storm last night.

cards.formula: isn't / aren't / wasn't / weren't · Is he…? Are they…? Was it…? Were you…?
cards.meaning: 否定在 be 後面加 not；問句把 be 搬到主詞前面。be 動詞不需要 do / does。
examples: Why aren't you talking?
Is it your birthday today?
The answers on the test aren't correct.

cards.formula: he / she / it + verb-s (listens, goes, washes, cries)
cards.meaning: 一般現在式說習慣或事實。第三人稱單數動詞要加 -s；字尾 sh / ch / s / x / o 加 -es；子音 + y 改成 -ies。
examples: Sherry listens carefully in class.
Tom washes the dishes after dinner.
The baby cries a lot.
My mom goes to work by MRT.

cards.meaning: 主詞是 I、you、複數（Jimmy and Alexia、most people、cats）動詞不加 -s。
examples: Jimmy and Alexia understand the rules of the game.
Cats like milk.
I firmly believe that you can achieve your goals.

cards.formula: does not + verb (he/she/it) · do not + verb (I/you/we/they) · Does he…? Do they…?
cards.meaning: 否定和問句用 do / does 幫忙，後面的動詞回到原形，不再加 -s。
examples: My sister does not drink coffee.
Most people from England do not speak Japanese.
Does your dad work on Saturdays?
Do they like pizza?

cards.formula: one of / each of / everyone → singular · nouns + phrase → look at the head noun · there is/are → nearest noun
cards.meaning: 高標題常把主詞藏起來：one of my cousins、each of the gadgets、everyone 都是單數；the boxes on the shelf 看 boxes（複數）；there is / are 跟後面最近的名詞一致；mathematics、news 是單數，scissors、trousers 是複數。
examples: One of my cousins is a pilot.
The boxes on the top shelf are heavy.
Everyone in the class needs a partner.
There is a pencil and two erasers in my bag.
Mathematics is my favorite subject.

tips: 先找「真正的主詞」：把 of the …、on the …、who … 這種片語蓋住再看。One of my friends (is)、The boxes on the shelf (are)。
everyone / everybody / nobody / each / one of → 單數：is / was / verb-s / does。
there is / are、there was / were 看後面最近的名詞：There is a book and two pens. / There are two pens and a book.
看到 does not、do not、Does、Do，後面動詞一定回到原形：She doesn't like（不是 likes）。
be 動詞不用 do：Is your brother good at soccer?（狀態）vs. Does your brother like soccer?（動作）。
時間線索：now / every day / always / on Mondays → 現在；yesterday / last night / this morning / ago / when I was… → 過去 was / were。
字尾規則：sh / ch / s / x / o → -es（washes, goes）；子音 + y → -ies（studies, cries）；母音 + y → -s（plays, enjoys）。

items.q: One of my cousins ____ a pilot in the air force.
The boxes on the top shelf ____ too heavy for me.
Everyone in the class ____ a partner for the project.
____ your brother good at soccer?
____ your brother like soccer?
There ____ a pencil and two erasers in my bag.
The twins ____ at school yesterday because they were sick.
Mathematics ____ my favorite subject, but the tests ____ hard.
How often ____ he ____ the piano?
Where ____ you an hour ago? Nobody could find you.
Which sentence is correct?
Which sentence is correct?
choices: Each of the gadgets were broken.
Each of the gadgets was broken.
Each of the gadgets are broken.
Each of the gadget were broken.

items.q: My friends who are in the band ____ me to play the drums.
"____ the students in the auditorium?" "Yes, they ____."
The news about the field trip ____ good, so everybody ____ happy.
Neither of the answers ____ correct, and the teacher ____ not happy about it.
Change to a question: "They were late for the concert."
choices: They were late for the concert, were?
Did they were late for the concert?
Were they late for the concert?
Was they late for the concert?

items.q: Change to negative: "My sister reads comics every night."
choices: My sister do not read comics every night.
My sister not reads comics every night.
My sister does not reads comics every night.
My sister does not read comics every night.
